name: drawwithsmile
description: DrawWithSmile - a free, open-source real-time multiplayer drawing and guessing game.

scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w server
scripts.build:client: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w client/drawwithsmile-web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client/drawwithsmile-web
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client/drawwithsmile-web
